messages:
alice.nguyen: Heads up — staging promote is blocked by CI. integration/job-4 failing with artifact checksum mismatch for `front_bundle`.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Promote stalled for release/2026-03-19-rc3
• job: ci/integration
• status: failed
• reason: artifact validation failed (checksum mismatch)
• logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1234

bob.lee: I see same in the logs: `GET artifact://registry/eu-west/front_bundle.tar.gz -> 404` then `validation failed: expected sha256:6f7a9e got sha256:abcd12`

carla: looks like the registry returned a partial object then connection reset during upload. upload sequence shows `upload started` then `connection reset by peer` around 10:12:03 UTC.

jamie: can someone try re-downloading the artifact from the registry and check checksum locally? if CI pulled a bad blob we should confirm before re-running all jobs.

alice.nguyen: I ran `curl -fL "$ARTIFACT_URL" -o front.tar.gz && sha256sum front.tar.gz` on a bastion — checksum is `sha256:abcd12` (mismatch). so registry has a bad object.

infra-oncall: I'm invalidating cache prefix `front_bundle/*` in eu-west registry now (started). should propagate in ~2-3m. I'll also check blob storage for partial objects and retry fixes.

bob.lee: short-term mitigation: pin the canary to the last-known-good artifact digest `sha256:6f7a9e` and promote that instead of re-running the broken artifact. avoids rollback of the whole release.

carla: +1 for pin. deploybot supports pinning with `--artifact-digest`. I'll prepare the promote command if infra confirms pin-safe.

deploy-bot: To pin: run `deploybot promote --env=staging --ref=release/2026-03-19-rc3 --artifact-digest=sha256:6f7a9e --reason="pin to last-known-good artifact due to registry checksum race"`

alice.nguyen: infra-oncall, after invalidation, can you confirm that re-upload from CI will succeed? we may need to retry jobs after cache flush.

infra-oncall: cache invalidation complete. I found a stalled multipart upload for `front_bundle` and aborted it. storage returned `416` for a tail-range during one upload attempt. I've re-scanned for orphaned parts and triggered background repair. Recommend promoting pinned digest now, then re-run integration with a fresh artifact push.

jamie: sounds good. I'll queue a re-run of `ci/integration` once we confirm promotion pinned. if the re-run still pulls bad blob we'll escalate to storage team and pause the release window.

carla: running pin promote now: `deploybot promote --env=staging --ref=release/2026-03-19-rc3 --artifact-digest=sha256:6f7a9e --reason="pin to known-good"` -> started.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Promote started for release/2026-03-19-rc3 (pinned).
• env: staging
• artifact-digest: sha256:6f7a9e
• status: in_progress

alice.nguyen: thanks all. leaving this thread open until integration re-run passes. will update if storage repair shows more orphaned uploads.

bob.lee: note for release notes: record that rc3 had a registry multipart upload race in eu-west and we pinned artifact sha256:6f7a9e for staging promote. follow-up: run a sweep for other uploads in the same time window.

infra-oncall: filing ticket INF-2026-117 to track storage multipart-failure root cause and cross-region sweep.

jamie: re-run queued: `ci/integration #4` -> started. tracking at https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1234#run-4

deploy-bot: [deploy] Promote completed for release/2026-03-19-rc3 (pinned). status: success

alice.nguyen: integration run finished: success. checksum now matches after reupload. marking this thread resolved.

carla: resolving and adding note to the release doc about pin and follow-up ticket INF-2026-117.
